1.title: Nanchang Metro Line 1 Extension Opens, Connecting Changbei Airport
1.summary: Line 1 Extension (Changbei Airport - Maqiu) opened on June 28, 2025, operating 6:00-23:00, extended to 23:30 on Fridays, weekends, and holidays. Single trip takes 85 minutes, connecting Changbei Airport, Nanchang East Station and other hubs.

2.title: Metro Ticket Purchase and Payment Guide for Expatriates
2.summary: Expatriates can purchase tickets at customer service centers at stations like Zhujiang Road Station and Metro Building Station on Lines 1-4 using VISA, Master and other foreign bank cards. Ticket vending machines support Chinese and English interfaces. 7 gate-passing methods are supported including Lulu Xing APP, Alipay/WeChat 'Travel' code.

3.title: Jiangxi Electric Bicycle Fire Safety Management Regulations Issued
3.summary: The first provincial local regulation targeting electric bicycle fire safety management in China will take effect on March 1, 2026. Expatriates need to understand relevant regulatory requirements.

4.title: Railway 12306 Ticket Purchase Guide for Expatriates
4.summary: The official ticket booking app 'Railway 12306' supports foreign mobile number registration and login. Passport real-name authentication is required before ticket purchase, with online authentication review taking about 3-5 working days.

5.title: Nanchang Cruise Night Tour Service
5.summary: Passing landmarks like Tengwang Pavilion, Qiushui Square, and Nanchang Star Ferris Wheel, you can watch the Guinness World Record light show composed of 362 high-rise buildings along the river. Regular night tours have three departures at 19:00, 20:05, and 21:15.

1.question: How can expatriates purchase tickets at metro stations?
1.answer: Expatriates can purchase tickets at customer service centers at stations like Zhujiang Road Station and Metro Building Station on Lines 1-4 using VISA, Master and other foreign bank cards. Ticket vending machines support Chinese and English interfaces, making operation simple and convenient. 7 gate-passing methods are also available including Lulu Xing APP, Alipay/WeChat 'Travel' code, and UnionPay QuickPass.

2.question: What are the operating hours of Nanchang Metro?
2.answer: Line 1 Extension operates 6:00-23:00, extended to 23:30 on Fridays, weekends, and holidays. Line 2 East Extension opened simultaneously, seamlessly connecting with Nanchang East Station. Line 4 will suspend operations between Baimashan Station and Lizhuangshan Station from September 2 to December 31, 2025, with free bus shuttle service provided during this period.

3.question: How can expatriates purchase train tickets?
3.answer: You can use the official ticket booking app 'Railway 12306', which supports foreign mobile number registration and login. Passport real-name authentication is required before ticket purchase, with online authentication review taking about 3-5 working days. If time is urgent, you can go to offline high-speed rail station manual counters for authentication review, which takes about 10 minutes. Foreign bank cards or WeChat/Alipay can be used for payment.

4.question: What transportation options are available from Changbei Airport to the city?
4.answer: You can choose: 1. Metro Line 1 Extension, direct to Changbei Airport Station, operating 6:00-23:00; 2. Airport bus, from railway station to Changbei Airport, passing Zhanqian Road, Bayi Avenue, etc.; 3. Taxi or ride-hailing; 4. Self-driving. It is recommended to choose the appropriate method based on destination and luggage situation.

5.question: What is the on-campus transportation at Nanchang University?
5.answer: Qianhu Campus has two campus circular bus routes covering core areas like Tianjian Garden and Library, operating 7:00-21:30, with peak frequency of 6 minutes/bus and off-peak frequency of 12 minutes/bus. Fare is 0.9 yuan, supporting Alipay 'Hongcheng Yikatong' QR code scanning. There are also 2,600 Qingju bikes on campus, with students and faculty enjoying unlimited rides for 6.9 yuan/month after certification.

6.question: How to book cruise night tour service?
6.answer: Passing landmarks like Tengwang Pavilion, Qiushui Square, and Nanchang Star Ferris Wheel, you can watch the Guinness World Record light show composed of 362 high-rise buildings along the river. Regular night tours have three departures at 19:00, 20:05, and 21:15. Regular tickets start at 110 yuan, VIP tickets start at 158 yuan. Some departures offer the immersive performance 'New Pipa Song'.
